ipa.curves.forward_curves.SwapZcCurveParameters

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.forward_curves.SwapZcCurveParameters.

Syntax

SwapZcCurveParameters(
    *,
    interest_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | None = None,
    calendar_adjustment: CalendarAdjustment | None = None,
    calendars: list[str] = None,
    compounding_type: CompoundingType | None = None,
    convexity_adjustment: ConvexityAdjustment | None = None,
    extrapolation_mode: ExtrapolationMode | None = None,
    interpolation_mode: InterpolationMode | None = None,
    price_side: PriceSide | None = None,
    steps: Iterable[Step] = None,
    turns: Iterable[Turn] = None,
    ignore_existing_definition: bool | None = None,
    reference_tenor: str | None = None,
    use_convexity_adjustment: bool | None = None,
    use_multi_dimensional_solver: bool | None = None,
    use_steps: bool | None = None,
    valuation_date: OptDateTime = None,
    market_data_access_denied_fallback: MarketDataAccessDeniedFallback | None = None,
    pivot_curve_parameters: InterestRateCurveParameters | None = None,
    reference_curve_parameters: InterestRateCurveParameters | None = None,
    valuation_time: ValuationTime | None = None,
    ignore_invalid_instrument: bool | None = None,
    use_delayed_data_if_denied: bool | None = None,
    valuation_date_time: OptDateTime = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
interest_calculation_method DayCountBasis | None No None Day count basis of the calculated zero coupon rates. Default value is: Dcb_Actual_Actual
calendar_adjustment CalendarAdjustment | None No None Cash flow adjustment according to a calendar No: Null: Weekend: for cash flow pricing using the calendar WeekendCalendar: for cash flow pricing using the calendar defined by the parameter 'calendars'.
calendars list[str] No None A list of one or more calendar codes used to define non-working days and to adjust coupon dates and values.
compounding_type CompoundingType | None No None
convexity_adjustment ConvexityAdjustment | None No None
extrapolation_mode ExtrapolationMode | None No None None: no extrapolation Constant: constant extrapolation Linear: linear extrapolation
interpolation_mode InterpolationMode | None No None Interpolation method used in swap zero curve bootstrap. Default value is: CubicSpline CubicDiscount: local cubic interpolation of discount factors CubicRate: local cubic interpolation of rates CubicSpline: a natural cubic spline Linear: linear interpolation Log: log linear interpolation ForwardMonotoneConvex
price_side PriceSide | None No None Defines which data is used for the rate surface computation. Default value is: Mid
steps Iterable[Step] No None Use to calculate the swap rate surface discount curve, when OIS is selected as discount curve. The steps can specify overnight index stepped dates or/and rates.
turns Iterable[Turn] No None Used to include end period rates/turns when calculating swap rate surfaces
ignore_existing_definition bool | None No None
reference_tenor str | None No None Root tenor(s) for the xIbor dependencies
use_convexity_adjustment bool | None No None false / true Default value is: true. It indicates if the system needs to retrieve the convexity adjustment
use_multi_dimensional_solver bool | None No None false / true
Default value is: true.
Specifies the use of the multi-dimensional solver for yield curve bootstrapping.
This solving method is required because the bootstrapping method sometimes
creates a ZC curve which does not accurately reprice the input instruments used
to build it.
The multi-dimensional solver is recommended when cubic interpolation methods
are used in building the curve
(in other cases, performance might be inferior to the regular bootstrapping
method).
- true: to use multi-dimensional solver for yield curve bootstrapping
- false: not to use multi-dimensional solver for yield curve bootstrapping
use_steps bool | None No None false / true Default value is: false. It indicates if the system needs to retrieve the overnight index stepped dates or/and rates
valuation_date OptDateTime No None The valuation date Default value is the current date
market_data_access_denied_fallback MarketDataAccessDeniedFallback | None No None If at leat one constituent access is denied:
* returnerror: dont price the surface and return an error (default value)
* ignoreconstituents: price the surface without the error market data
* usedelayeddata: use delayed market data if possible
pivot_curve_parameters InterestRateCurveParameters | None No None The list of parameters used to define the pivot curve which is used for evaluation of the adjusted zero coupon curve. for example, eur zero curve adjusted with gbp curve, using usd as a pivot.
reference_curve_parameters InterestRateCurveParameters | None No None The list of parameters used to define the reference curve which is used for evaluation of the adjusted zero coupon curve. for example, eur zero curve is adjusted with gbp curve.
valuation_time ValuationTime | None No None The time identified by offsets at which the zero coupon curve is generated.
ignore_invalid_instrument bool | None No None Ignore invalid instrument to calculate the curve. If false and some instrument are invlide, the curve is not calculated and an error is returned. the default value is 'True'.
use_delayed_data_if_denied bool | None No None Use delayed ric to retrieve data when not permissioned on constituent ric. The default value is 'False'.
valuation_date_time OptDateTime No None The date and time at which the zero coupon curve is generated. The value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddt00:00:00z (e.g., '2021-01-01t14:00:00z' or '2021-01-01t14:00:00+02:00'). Only one parameter of valuation_date and valuation_date_time must be specified.
